screening_rule: Promote only if event-calibrated selection exceeds both calibrated-fidelity and development-selected fixed method in mean log useful-probability ratio in each noise profile, with a positive pooled paired-instance bootstrap lower endpoint against both. This is an exploratory local screen, not hardware evidence or a confirmatory significance claim.
limitations: Independent local depolarizing gate channels plus symmetric readout, no idle decoherence/crosstalk/coherent errors/drift. Exact states and exact event enumeration. All 2026 Nighthawk outcomes were already seen and are not held-out evidence for this rule.
